text: The OMEGAMON Monitoring agent can automatically issue MQSC configuration commands when its **Take Action** facility is enabled and the user has the necessary authority. When the agent is monitoring a queue manager, it may use this facility to adjust queue attributes (e.g., via `ALTER QLOCAL`) to keep the environment in the desired state. This behavior is documented in the OMEGAMON documentation, which states that the Monitoring agent “offers the Take Action facility to issue any MQSC configuration command if the user is authorized”【1】.
